description:
The ticket's contract line "work-start reason and exact demanded fact/product"
has no coverage today.

`World::demand_fact_producer` (`drive.rs:185`) emits nothing. `WorkStartReason`
is only ever aggregated into `WorkStartTally` (`scheduler.rs:160`) and reported
once per session -- so the log says 873 work starts were
`BlockedWaiterExpansion` but never which fact caused any one of them.

## The cheap existing answer

`fz.compiler2.drive.demand_on_stall` already carries
`(&usize producer_pokes, &HashSet<FactKey> demanded_facts)` (`drive.rs:497`,
projected `jsonl.rs:371`) and is NOT allowlisted. Allowlist it and project full
`FactKey`s rather than kinds. Add the `WorkStartReason` if per-expansion
attribution needs it.

Prefer this to inventing a new event: check what already exists before adding an
emitter (`.agent/docs/telemetry.md` emit-point rules).

## Red test

TDD 3: pin a blocked wait and its exact fact-to-producer expansion.

## Note for fz-kdt.46

That ticket replaces the drain-time unresolved-wait scan with edge-triggered
pulls and asserts "every BlockedWaiterExpansion names the exact newly recorded
FactUse that caused it". This child is what makes that assertion writable.

Interaction with fz-kdt.50: that ticket deletes three dead allowlist rows, one of
which (`drive.stalled`) looks like the lost half of a rename of
`demand_on_stall`. If this child allowlists `demand_on_stall`, say so there.
title: Work-start attribution: name the exact demanded fact and its reason
